origin.description: Replaces each tab with the spaces that reach the next stop. ctl only decides which sequences have zero width.
origin.usage: tabs_as_spaces(x, tab.stops = getOption("fansi.tab.stops", 8L), warn = getOption("fansi.warn", TRUE), ctl = "all")
origin.details: Replaces each tab with the spaces that reach the next stop. ctl only decides which sequences have zero width. An omitted wrap width is 72, which is 0.9 times the default R width of 80.

translation.description: Replaces each tab with the spaces that reach the next stop. ctl only decides which sequences have zero width.
translation.details: Replaces each tab with the spaces that reach the next stop. ctl only decides which sequences have zero width. An omitted wrap width is 72. A string is one element. None is a missing string. Dotted R names are written with underscores.
